safePurpose: Review only self-entered E. coli report wording and arsenic, fluoride and turbidity values, together with sample/report context and an official local advisory selection.
privacy: Treat report values and sample dates as sensitive local data. Do not request addresses, sample identifiers or account details and do not store, log, upload, sync, email, place entries in URLs or send them to analytics.
disallowed: overriding a boil-water or do-not-drink advisory
inferring safety from taste, smell, appearance, source type or incomplete results
turning a detection limit into a zero E. coli count
claiming the report belongs to the intended sample
choosing or prescribing a treatment recipe
staticText: Drinking-Water Test Result Worksheet for /tools/water-quality/. Review only self-entered E. coli report wording and arsenic, fluoride and turbidity values against documented limited references, together with the user-selected sample/report context and official local advisory status. E. coli detection and exceeded values require qualified local interpretation; turbidity above 1 through 5 NTU is operational caution and above 5 NTU is a fallback operational flag. Never certify water as safe, override a boil-water or do-not-drink advisory, infer safety from source type, taste, smell, appearance or incomplete results, turn a detection limit into zero, claim a report belongs to the intended sample, or choose a treatment recipe. Results and sample dates are sensitive and local: do not request addresses or identifiers and do not store, log, upload, sync, email, add entries to URLs or send them to analytics. Sources reviewed 2026-07-26: WHO Drinking-water fact sheet and Guidelines for drinking-water quality, fourth edition incorporating the first, second and third addenda (17 June 2026).
